name: shop
description: A full-stack Quanarch application in Node.js: a quanar server, a qua, three quans and a React client.

scripts.setup: npm i --prefix packages/shop-qua && npm i --prefix quanar && npm i --prefix quans/users && npm i --prefix quans/products && npm i --prefix quans/orders && npm i --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/shop-qua && npm run build --prefix quans/users && npm run build --prefix quans/products && npm run build --prefix quans/orders && node scripts/register.mjs && npm run build --prefix quanar
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix quanar && npm run typecheck --prefix quans/users && npm run typecheck --prefix quans/products && npm run typecheck --prefix quans/orders && npm run typecheck --prefix web
